rules.name: lal-cutoff-01-check
rules.sql: SELECT l.business_unit, max(v.value_date) AS valuation_date, count(*) AS cache_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.value_date > v.value_date) AS rows_after_valuation_date, max(l.value_date) AS newest_cache_value_date, max(l.updated_timestamp) AS newest_cache_update FROM opera.latest_active_lot l JOIN opera.valuation_date_table v ON v.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND v.business_unit = l.business_unit GROUP BY l.business_unit ORDER BY 4 DESC, 1

SELECT t.tgname AS trigger_name, c.relname AS table_name, t.tgenabled AS enabled FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgname IN ('trg_sync_latest_active_lot', 'trg_latest_active_lot_history_truncate', 'trg_latest_active_lot_valuation_date', 'trg_latest_active_lot_valuation_truncate') ORDER BY 1

WITH cut AS ( SELECT v.tenant_id, v.business_unit, max(v.value_date) AS d FROM opera.valuation_date_table v GROUP BY v.tenant_id, v.business_unit ), expected AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.tenant_id, d.business_unit, d.trade_id) d.tenant_id, d.business_unit, d.trade_id, d.value_date, d.active_lots FROM opera.deal_active_lots_table d JOIN cut c ON c.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND c.business_unit = d.business_unit AND d.value_date <= c.d ORDER BY d.tenant_id, d.business_unit, d.trade_id, d.value_date DESC ), actual AS ( SELECT l.tenant_id, l.business_unit, l.trade_id, l.value_date, l.active_lots FROM opera.latest_active_lot l ), j AS ( SELECT coalesce(e.tenant_id, a.tenant_id) AS tenant_id, coalesce(e.business_unit, a.business_unit) AS business_unit, e.trade_id AS e_trade, a.trade_id AS a_trade, (e.value_date IS DISTINCT FROM a.value_date OR e.active_lots IS DISTINCT FROM a.active_lots) AS diff FROM expected e FULL JOIN actual a ON a.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND a.business_unit = e.business_unit AND a.trade_id = e.trade_id ) SELECT j.business_unit, count(j.e_trade) AS expected_rows, count(j.a_trade) AS cache_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.a_trade IS NULL) AS missing, count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.e_trade IS NULL) AS extra, count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.e_trade IS NOT NULL AND j.a_trade IS NOT NULL AND j.diff) AS different FROM j GROUP BY j.business_unit ORDER BY 5 DESC, 4 DESC, 1

SELECT d.business_unit, count(*) AS trades_first_row_after_valuation FROM (SELECT a.tenant_id, a.business_unit, a.trade_id, min(a.value_date) AS first_d FROM opera.deal_active_lots_table a GROUP BY a.tenant_id, a.business_unit, a.trade_id) d JOIN (SELECT v.tenant_id, v.business_unit, max(v.value_date) AS cut FROM opera.valuation_date_table v GROUP BY v.tenant_id, v.business_unit) c ON c.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND c.business_unit = d.business_unit WHERE d.first_d > c.cut GROUP BY d.business_unit ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1

expect.reason: at least one BU has cache rows
no cache row may be newer than its BU valuation date
the four latest_active_lot triggers must exist on opera
no trade missing from the cache
no cache trade without a row up to the valuation date
no cache row with another date or lots
